mentions.description: A build system for C (and potentially C++) called cbs.h that lets projects be built by writing the build logic in C itself, similar to how Zig uses build.zig.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on (another) build system for C and potentially C++ called 'cbs.h', the idea is to use C to build the project similar to how Zig uses build.zig.
